test.summary: SPM - Workday - Checking Workday integration Tooltips
test.description:
In order to conduct this test case you have to enable following Feature Flag in console:

window.enableFF('WorkdayAbsenceSyncEnabledFeatureFlag')

steps.result:
Individuals list is displayed

Following buttons are displayed at the top-right:

* Refresh Workday absences (grayed out)
* Synchronize with Tempo
* Assign To
* Add new Individual
Tooltip ‘To refresh Workday absences, configure Workday integration’ is displayed

steps.action: Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName and select
steps.result: Paulina Sendecka is displayed on the list

steps.action: Click on userName to open Resource details page
steps.result: User details page is displayed at the right-top there’s a button with a tooltip ‘To refresh Workday absences, configure Workday integration’
Tooltip ‘To refresh Workday absences, configure Workday integration’ is displayed

steps.action: Navigate to App Configuration → Integrations → Workday
steps.result:
'Workday absences integration

Syncing with Workday lets you replace BigPicture absences with those from Workday. This integration is permanent and can cause data loss. Synchronization takes place once a day.' is displayed

Workday Credentials are displayed with chevron and following fields: 

* Client ID (with red asterisk)
* Client Secret (with red asterisk)
* Refresh Token (with red asterisk)
* Workday REST API Endpoint (with red asterisk)
* Token Endpoint (with red asterisk)

Below the input fields, there’s ‘Start sync with Workday from’ (with red asterisk)

Today’s date is set as a placeholder 

‘How to get credentials’ redirects to..

Save button is grayed out
Client ID is filled with data
Client Secret is filled with data
Refresh token is filled with data
Workday REST API Endpoint is filled with data
Token endpoint is filled with data

Save button changes into ‘Chcecking credentials’ and it’s gray, there’s animation with loading button

After the credentials are checked, 2 buttons are displayed:

* Green button with tick icon and text ‘Saved credentials are correct’
* Remove integration

After a while, only grayed out ‘Save’ button and active 'Remove Integration' buttons are displayed

Individuals tab is displayed.

Following Buttons are displayed in the right corner of Individuals tab:

* Refresh Workday absences with tooltip ‘Refresh all absences from Workday. This may take some time if there are many individuals'
* Synchronize with Tempo (if Tempo is not installed the button is grayed out)
* Assign to
* + Add new individual

steps.action: Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName and select
steps.result: Paulina Sendecka is displayed on the list

steps.action: Click on userName to open Resource details page
steps.result: User details page is displayed at the right-top there’s a grayed out button ‘Refresh Workday absences’
Tooltip ‘Refresh all Workday absences in order to later refresh individual one.'

steps.action: Go back to  Administration → Resources → Individuals and click Refresh Workday absences
steps.result:
Refresh Workday absences button is gray and has a loading icon

In the left corner there’s blue message

'Synchronization with Workday in progress

The synchronization of absences from Workday is currently in progress. We will notify you once it has been completed'

After few seconds, green message is displayed ‘Synchronization with Workday finished’

steps.action: Navigate to Resources module of a boxName
steps.data: boxName: TC-5158 SPM - Workday - Checking Workday integration Tooltip
steps.result:
Resources module is displayed

Timeline is starting from 01/Dec/24

Task 1 is assigned to Paulina Sendecka
‘Add absence' option is inactive and grayed out with a tooltip ‘Absences are managed automatically by Workday and cannot be modified manually.’
‘Add absence' option is inactive and grayed out with a tooltip ‘Absences are managed automatically by Workday and cannot be modified manually.’

rag.text:
Test: TC-5158 — SPM - Workday - Checking Workday integration Tooltips
Priority: High | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/TS-505 Workday
Labels: spm-paulina-tc, teamace, teamresources

Description:
In order to conduct this test case you have to enable following Feature Flag in console:

window.enableFF('WorkdayAbsenceSyncEnabledFeatureFlag')

Steps:
1. Navigate to Administration → Resources → Individuals
   Expected: Individuals list is displayed

Following buttons are displayed at the top-right:

* Refresh Workday absences (grayed out)
* Synchronize with Tempo
* Assign To
* Add new Individual
2. Hover over 'Refresh Workday absences' button
   Expected: Tooltip ‘To refresh Workday absences, configure Workday integration’ is displayed
3. Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName and select
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: Paulina Sendecka is displayed on the list
4. Click on userName to open Resource details page
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: User details page is displayed at the right-top there’s a button with a tooltip ‘To refresh Workday absences, configure Workday integration’
5. Hover over 'Refresh Workday absences' button
   Expected: Tooltip ‘To refresh Workday absences, configure Workday integration’ is displayed
6. Navigate to App Configuration → Integrations → Workday
   Expected: 'Workday absences integration

Syncing with Workday lets you replace BigPicture absences with those from Workday. This integration is permanent and can cause data loss. Synchronization takes place once a day.' is displayed

Workday Credentials are displayed with chevron and following fields: 

* Client ID (with red asterisk)
* Client Secret (with red asterisk)
* Refresh Token (with red asterisk)
* Workday REST API Endpoint (with red asterisk)
* Token Endpoint (with red asterisk)

Below the input fields, there’s ‘Start sync with Workday from’ (with red asterisk)

Today’s date is set as a placeholder 

‘How to get credentials’ redirects to..

Save button is grayed out
7. Type Client ID
   Data: Client ID: {{NzlkZDgzMmQtNmU0My00OGYxLTljYmUtZjZhY2I2ZDhmY2E2}}
   Expected: Client ID is filled with data
8. Type Client Secret
   Data: Client Secret: {{6cdxfty24hv4jtteew82yfwa36fhinqrhr314z9wwuwwras57f4o4y6o4d1vknpat3vcamva848lplsyjai58456154ncheve19}}
   Expected: Client Secret is filled with data
9. Type Refresh token
   Data: Refresh token: {{pmn6pq349whg90v1oeqs98w3ok0ecu10jeldthgwtz1var270sll0ihj48z61jztt57un558q12lz3gsq0d805phap4wvcv1zw8}}
   Expected: Refresh token is filled with data
10. Type Workday REST API Endpoint
   Data: Type Workday REST API Endpoint: {{https://services1.wd12.myworkday.com/ccx/api/v1/appfire}}
   Expected: Workday REST API Endpoint is filled with data
11. Type Token Endpoint
   Data: Token Endpoint: {{https://services1.wd12.myworkday.com/ccx/oauth2/appfire/token}}
   Expected: Token endpoint is filled with data
12. Select startDate and click Save
   Data: startDate: 01/Jan/24
   Expected: Save button changes into ‘Chcecking credentials’ and it’s gray, there’s animation with loading button

After the credentials are checked, 2 buttons are displayed:

* Green button with tick icon and text ‘Saved credentials are correct’
* Remove integration

After a while, only grayed out ‘Save’ button and active 'Remove Integration' buttons are displayed
13. Navigate to Administration → Resources → Individuals
   Expected: Individuals tab is displayed.

Following Buttons are displayed in the right corner of Individuals tab:

* Refresh Workday absences with tooltip ‘Refresh all absences from Workday. This may take some time if there are many individuals'
* Synchronize with Tempo (if Tempo is not installed the button is grayed out)
* Assign to
* + Add new individual
14. Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName and select
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: Paulina Sendecka is displayed on the list
15. Click on userName to open Resource details page
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: User details page is displayed at the right-top there’s a grayed out button ‘Refresh Workday absences’
16. Hover over ‘Refresh Workday absences’
   Expected: Tooltip ‘Refresh all Workday absences in order to later refresh individual one.'
17. Go back to  Administration → Resources → Individuals and click Refresh Workday absences
   Expected: Refresh Workday absences button is gray and has a loading icon

In the left corner there’s blue message

'Synchronization with Workday in progress

The synchronization of absences from Workday is currently in progress. We will notify you once it has been completed'

After few seconds, green message is displayed ‘Synchronization with Workday finished’
18. Navigate to Resources module of a boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-5158 SPM - Workday - Checking Workday integration Tooltip
   Expected: Resources module is displayed

Timeline is starting from 01/Dec/24

Task 1 is assigned to Paulina Sendecka
19. Right-click on Avatar of userName
   Data: userName: Paulina Sendecka
   Expected: ‘Add absence' option is inactive and grayed out with a tooltip ‘Absences are managed automatically by Workday and cannot be modified manually.’
20. Right-click on workload of userName
   Data: userName: Paulina Sendecka
   Expected: ‘Add absence' option is inactive and grayed out with a tooltip ‘Absences are managed automatically by Workday and cannot be modified manually.’
